commute_evening_focus.title: The 'Hot Food First' Dinner Relief
commute_evening_focus.action: The second dinner is ready, take the baby and insist she sits and eats her plate while it is fresh and piping hot. Stay-at-home moms constantly eat cold meals with one hand.
commute_evening_focus.why: Eating an undisturbed, warm dinner with both hands is an instant, deeply appreciated act of service.

commute_evening_focus.title: Immediate Doorway Swap & 15-Minute Quiet Room
commute_evening_focus.action: Walk in, give her a warm hug, and immediately take the baby. Tell her: 'Go into the bedroom, shut the door, and take 15 quiet minutes to lay down or breathe before dinner. I've got everything out here.'
commute_evening_focus.why: Gives her a critical decompression buffer between solo parenting and evening dinner rush.

commute_evening_focus.title: Dinner Triage & Decision Elimination
commute_evening_focus.action: Don't ask 'What's for dinner?' when you arrive. Walk into the kitchen, check what's cooking or prepped, and take over stirring, heating, or plating.
commute_evening_focus.why: Eliminates decision fatigue and removes the physical burden of finishing dinner.

commute_evening_focus.title: Silent 15-Second Hug (Zero Demand for Words)
commute_evening_focus.action: When you walk in, skip the conversational interview. Put down your bag, wrap both arms around her for 15 solid seconds, and let her lean into you without having to talk.
commute_evening_focus.why: She has answered demands and cries all day; physical reassurance without verbal demands is pure relief.

commute_evening_focus.title: Hydration Station & Cold Drink Hand-off
commute_evening_focus.action: Fill a cold tumbler with ice water or a flavored seltzer and hand it directly to her right after taking the baby off her arms.
commute_evening_focus.why: Holding a fussy baby all afternoon often means she hasn't stopped to drink water in hours.

commute_evening_focus.title: Shoulder-to-Shoulder Kitchen Tag Team
commute_evening_focus.action: Hold the baby while hanging out right beside her in the kitchen, keeping conversation light and keeping baby soothed so she can move freely.
commute_evening_focus.why: Transforms isolated cooking into shared, connected teamwork.

commute_evening_focus.title: Post-Dinner Fast Kitchen Reset
commute_evening_focus.action: As dinner wraps up, tell her: 'Leave the dishes right there. Go sit on the couch or nurse/soothe baby—I am clearing the counters and running the dishwasher.'
commute_evening_focus.why: Prevents evening mess from lingering into tomorrow's painful morning.

commute_evening_focus.title: The 'Eat With Both Hands' Guarantee
commute_evening_focus.action: Ensure that tonight she does not hold baby during dinner. You wear or hold baby so she gets to use a fork and knife with zero multitasking.
commute_evening_focus.why: A simple everyday luxury that parents of fussy babies rarely get.

commute_evening_focus.title: Bedtime Routine Takeover Offer
commute_evening_focus.action: Say before 6:30 PM: 'I'll take bath time and pajamas tonight so you can take a shower or start unwinding early.'
commute_evening_focus.why: Takes the heaviest evening hurdle off her shoulders.

commute_evening_focus.title: Low-Stimulation Evening Ambiance
commute_evening_focus.action: Dim harsh overhead kitchen/living room lights and put on low, soft background music to lower the nervous system volume after a fussy day.
commute_evening_focus.why: Creates a calm sanctuary when both of you are running on empty.

commute_evening_focus.title: Takeout / Leftover Rescue
commute_evening_focus.action: If you notice she's had an unusually rough day, offer: 'Let's keep tonight zero-effort. Let's reheat quick leftovers or order simple Thai so nobody cooks.'
commute_evening_focus.why: Prioritizes survival and mental health over cooking expectations.

commute_evening_focus.title: The 'I've Got It From Here' Hand-off
commute_evening_focus.action: Look her in the eyes as you take the baby and say softly: 'You survived today. I'm home now, and I've got you both.'
commute_evening_focus.why: Hearing those words resets her stress levels and provides emotional safety.

acts_of_service.title: Morning Coffee Prep & Hydration Station
acts_of_service.action: Before heading out to work, set up her coffee mug and fill an ice water tumbler with a quick note: 'Fuel for the best mom. I love you.'
acts_of_service.why: Helps ease sleep-deprived mornings before her day starts.

acts_of_service.title: Unprompted Baby Laundry Fold
acts_of_service.action: Take one basket of clean baby clothes or bibs and fold/put it away completely without being asked.
acts_of_service.why: Baby laundry piles up relentlessly; knocking one out reduces invisible clutter.

acts_of_service.title: Car Gas & Windshield Clean
acts_of_service.action: Take her car for 10 minutes to top off the gas tank so she never has to stop at a gas station with a crying baby.

acts_of_service.title: Healthy Lunch Prep Support
acts_of_service.action: Pre-portion high-protein snacks or grill extra chicken for the fridge so her daytime lunches are effortless.
acts_of_service.why: Supports mutual health goals while taking daytime meal stress away.

acts_of_service.title: Diaper Bag & Stroller Reset
acts_of_service.action: Restock the diaper bag with fresh wipes, diapers, and a clean burp cloth so she never gets caught unprepared.
acts_of_service.why: Quietly takes mental load off her daily routine.

acts_of_service.title: Midnight Wake-up Duty Pass
acts_of_service.action: Tell her before turning off the lights: 'I'll take the first wake-up tonight so you can get a solid stretch of deep sleep.'
acts_of_service.why: Solid sleep is the greatest act of love during sleep-deprived seasons.

words_of_affirmation.title: Mid-Morning Effort Praise Voice Note
words_of_affirmation.action: Send a 30-second voice note mid-morning: 'I know today might be exhausting with baby, but you are doing an incredible job. Your patience is amazing, and I love you.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Directly acknowledges her hard work in the middle of a solitary morning.

words_of_affirmation.title: Bathroom Mirror Sticky Note
words_of_affirmation.action: Leave a small note on the bathroom mirror where she does her skincare: 'I see how hard you work every day for us. You are beautiful and deeply loved.'
words_of_affirmation.why: A quiet visual surprise that doesn't demand immediate response.

words_of_affirmation.title: Mid-Afternoon Encouragement Text
words_of_affirmation.action: Text her: 'Thinking of you right now. I know these days take so much energy, and I'm coming home ready to take over!'
words_of_affirmation.why: Reassures her that relief is coming at the end of the day.

words_of_affirmation.title: Quiet Living Room Compliment
words_of_affirmation.action: Catch her eye while sitting on the couch after baby is asleep and say: 'You look so gorgeous tonight. I'm so grateful for you.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Validates her identity as a desired partner, not just a mother.

words_of_affirmation.title: Gratitude for Unseen Labor
words_of_affirmation.action: Tell her quietly: 'I was thinking about all the soothing, feeding, and holding you do that nobody sees. I see it, and I appreciate you so much.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Makes hidden maternal effort feel recognized and honored.

creative_home_experiences.title: Living Room Low-Carb Dessert & Tea Hang
creative_home_experiences.action: After baby is asleep, brew warm chamomile or mint tea and serve a couple squares of dark chocolate on the couch in dim lighting.
creative_home_experiences.why: Zero-prep, zero-cost, restful connection in your own living room after dinner.

creative_home_experiences.title: 15-Minute Patio Star Wind-Down
creative_home_experiences.action: Step onto the back patio for 15 quiet minutes after baby's bedtime to breathe fresh night air together without TV or phones.
creative_home_experiences.why: A quick break from indoor domestic walls to decompress together.

creative_home_experiences.title: Couch Foot & Calf Rub Session
creative_home_experiences.action: Offer a 10-minute foot or calf rub while watching a show together on the couch, zero expectations attached.
creative_home_experiences.why: Relieves physical soreness from carrying the baby all day.

creative_home_experiences.title: Shared Libby Thriller Audiobook Chapter
creative_home_experiences.action: Suggest playing 15 minutes of her current Libby thriller over a small speaker while resting on the couch together.
creative_home_experiences.why: Shows genuine interest in her favorite unwind hobby without demanding active talk.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Drive-Thru Seasonal Coffee Drop-off
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Pick up a seasonal coffee drink on your way home and hand it to her right after taking the baby off her arms.
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: A delicious, thoughtful pick-me-up that shows you were thinking of her.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Hidden Sour Candy Stash
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Tuck a small bag of her favorite sour candy or licorice into her nightstand drawer with a note: 'For when you need a sweet moment.'
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: A fun private treat she can enjoy during her quiet shower/reading time.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Bakery Pastry Split
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Bring home a single artisanal bakery item on Friday to split together over coffee on Saturday morning.
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: Small shared indulgence that fits into a healthy lifestyle in moderation.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: New Hydrating Sheet Mask / Skincare Item
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Surprise her with a nice hydrating face sheet mask or body cream to elevate her evening shower/skincare ritual.
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: Directly supports her cherished self-care unwind routine.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Low-Pressure Check-In
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her while sitting together after dinner: 'What was the sweetest or funniest moment with baby today?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Helps reflect on positive parenting moments rather than the exhaustion.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Thriller Plot Question
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her: 'Who is your top suspect in your Libby book right now?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Gives her a fun mental escape to talk about her book instead of chores.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Support Check-In
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her: 'What is one thing tomorrow that I can take off your plate so your day feels lighter?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Proactively shares the mental load of home management.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Nostalgia Callback
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Reminisce together: 'Remember that hilarious moment when [funny shared memory]? I was just thinking about how much fun we have together.'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Re-ignites your identity as best friends and partners.

date_ideas.title: Low-Carb Thai Feast & Thriller Movie Night
date_ideas.prep: Order high-protein Thai takeout (Thai Basil Chicken, summer rolls) after baby is in bed at 7:30 PM. Dim living room lights, light candles, and watch a thrilling movie.
date_ideas.why: Zero babysitter needed, zero packing or driving, 100% relaxed atmosphere after baby is asleep.

date_ideas.title: Drive-Thru Seasonal Coffee Ride While Baby Naps
date_ideas.prep: Put baby in car seat for afternoon nap. Drive through a coffee spot for fun seasonal drinks, and chat in the front seats while baby sleeps in the back.
date_ideas.why: Zero stroller assembly, zero walking crowds, peaceful 1-on-1 front-seat conversation while baby is soothed by the drive.

date_ideas.title: Post-Bedtime Backyard Porch & Tea Date
date_ideas.prep: Step outside onto the back patio after baby is down with warm decaf teas or low-carb sparkling drinks under the patio lights.
date_ideas.why: Fresh air and quiet reconnection without leaving the house or spending money.

date_ideas.title: The 2-Hour Weekend Sleep Gift Swap
date_ideas.prep: One parent takes the baby out to the living room for 2 full hours on Saturday morning so the other gets uninterrupted, deep sleep.
date_ideas.why: Deep, unbroken sleep is the ultimate romantic luxury during baby months.

date_ideas.title: Couch Card/Trivia Game & Dark Chocolate Treat
date_ideas.prep: Pull out a quick, low-stress card or trivia game after baby's bedtime with dark chocolate or a low-carb sweet treat.
date_ideas.why: Playful, lighthearted connection at home with zero pressure.
